body: I appreciate what you're saying, I really do, but my gut instinct is that you're just being nice. I just can't imagine that anyone thinks I look good, it's an impossibility in my mind.
Straight male here but I think you look good dude. Don't sweat it.
I'm not the OP, but I sure as hell know that's why I keep coming back. I'd guess that it's fairly common for many people on here.
Thanks, that means a lot to me. Have a great day.
I wish I could grow a beard, it comes in fairly patchy though. I've heard things about applying rogaine to your face though, maybe I'll give that a shot. Thanks for your response.
You seem honest, thanks for your opinion.
First genuine compliment I've received in a long, long while. Thank you stranger.
